statistical_difference: Closed testing for model updating. Its comment records a MEASURED correction: a first draft tested each rung of the ladder at alpha and rejected 'no update' 10.8% of the time at a nominal 5% against 400 null replicates, because 1 - 0.95^2 = 9.75%. The shipped version tests the richest update against no-update FIRST and runs nothing below unless that gate is significant, so the step-down only chooses WHICH update, never whether.
